text:
Later this week, the lounge crew read your note with care and I am sorry that the care shown around your animal did not meet the standard you were entitled to expect from Aurelia Skyways. You described a journey in which the handoff process felt uncertain, the updates were too sparse, and the handling of your companion left you feeling that the animal's comfort was not treated with enough urgency.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk takes that concern seriously. Our work is built around steady coordination from booking through pickup, with calm and humane handling at every stage. When a traveler places trust in us, the duty is not only to move a pet safely between skyports, but also to communicate clearly and to protect the animal's routine as much as the journey allows. If a passenger leaves with doubts about that care, then we have work to do.

I have reviewed the complaint with the ground team responsible for companion animal service and with the welcome team that prepares passengers for boarding. The account points to a failure in communication rather than in intent, but that does not lessen the impact on you. A quiet, orderly process can still feel careless if the traveler is left uninformed. We are reinforcing the requirement that handlers explain each transfer plainly and confirm comfort checks before any handoff proceeds. We are also reminding staff that animals are to be guided with patience, never hurried, and never treated as cargo to be managed by convenience alone.

Your report has been entered for follow-up, and the service lead will use it to review the sequence of events and the timing of the updates you received. We appreciate that you took the time to speak up. Complaints of this kind help us correct weak points in the chain of care and keep the service aligned with the standards Aurelia Skyways promises.

Thank you for giving us the chance to respond. We are committed to restoring your confidence in our Companion Animal Travel Desk.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
